'''The Labyrinth''' was a network of passages located beneath the reactors of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].

==History==
The Labyrinth was secretly constructed by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]<ref name="TLCS" /> and designed by [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] best [[Architect/Legends|architect]] [[Garrbo V'Droz]].<ref name="His Finest Work" /> These chambers may have stretched for [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] below the surface and their purpose was unknown. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was unaware of "The Labyrinth's" existence.<ref name="TLCS" />
